homeEyebrow: A little card. A world of connection.
heroDescription: A birthday, a thank you, or a simple “thinking of you”. Bring your words together with a design inspired by the world’s cultures.
heroNote: Five cultures. Countless ways to care.
cultureMatch: A culture that feels like you
collectionTitle: A world of ways to say you care.
collectionDescription: Different traditions. The same human warmth. Find the culture that speaks to you.
processEyebrow: FROM YOUR HEART TO THEIR SCREEN
step1Body: Explore colours, symbols and traditions from around the world.
step2Body: Choose an occasion and write the words only you can say.
step3Body: Preview a living digital card, ready to share with someone special.
ctaBody: Make their day, one thoughtful card at a time.
createDescription: A few words from you. A cultural canvas for them.
messagePlaceholder: What would you like to tell them?
messageHint: Your words are preserved exactly. This demo does not generate AI content.
unsaved: Device storage unavailable; keep this tab open.
generateTitle: A little care in every detail.
generateNote: A simulated process. No AI request is made.
viewerTitle: A little piece of your heart.
viewerBody: Your cultural card is ready to experience.
shareError: Sharing is unavailable. Copy the link below.
fullScreenError: Full screen is unavailable in this browser.
missingBody: The link may be incomplete, or the card is stored on another device. Create a card to begin.
cultureDescription: Explore a few visual traditions. These collections are starting points for inspiration; personal preferences always come first.
cultureNote: Cultures are diverse and evolving. A location is a helpful starting point, and never defines a person’s identity.
settingsDescription: Choose what feels right. You can change these preferences at any time.
countryHelp: Updates the visual theme and language together.
languageHelp: Language is fixed to the selected country.
themeHelp: The visual theme follows your selected country.
motionHelp: Gentle movement in the illustrations. System reduced-motion preferences are always respected.
resetHelp: The current location endpoint is a mock and returns China. No real IP location is collected.
notFound: This page took a different path.
story.CN: A meeting of mountain landscapes, auspicious clouds and warm lantern light. Vermilion and gold carry a wish for joy and reunion.
story.JP: Soft sakura, the silhouette of Mount Fuji and the texture of washi. An invitation to pause and appreciate a fleeting moment.
story.US: Playful balloons, bright ribbons and an open, expressive rhythm. Celebrate a milestone with an unmistakably joyful gesture.
story.GB: A handwritten note, a carefully placed stamp and the warmth of afternoon tea. A small keepsake with a sense of occasion.
story.FR: Botanical sketches, Parisian silhouettes and the warmth of an artist’s paper. An expressive setting for a thoughtful note.
story.GLOBAL: An open canvas for a connected world. Quiet shapes and natural colours leave room for your own story.
errorTitle: This page needs a fresh start.
errorBody: Reload the page to try again.
connectionNote: A LITTLE THOUGHT, A LASTING CONNECTION
p2.chatLabel: Tell me what you have in mind
p2.chatPlaceholder: For example: a gentle birthday card for a friend, with flowers and plenty of space…
p2.createDescription: Write your wishes and describe the design. AI agents will create original artwork for your card.
p2.messagePlaceholder: Write your own greeting, or leave it blank for an original message in this country’s language.
p2.error.network_error: The service could not be reached. Check that the Docker services are running and try again.
p2.error.database_unavailable: The card library is temporarily unavailable. Please retry shortly.
p2.error.invalid_response: The service returned an unexpected response. Please retry.
p2.error.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
home.startNote: Describe your idea. We’ll find a design and create your card.
library.description: Every card you create is saved here, ready to open and share again.
library.emptyBody: Create a card and it will be added to your collection automatically.
library.deleteDescription: This cannot be undone. Its shared link will also stop working.
library.batchDeleteDescription: The selected cards will be permanently deleted and their shared links will stop working.
ai.queued: Your request is in the queue. Generation will start automatically.
ai.progressDescription: Specialist agents are collaborating on your brief. Your finished card will open automatically.
ai.leaveGeneration: Go to my cards · the finished card will be saved automatically
ai.imageUnavailable: The card image could not be loaded. Please refresh to try again.
ai.error.agnes_not_configured: The image service is not configured. Add the Agnes key to the local backend configuration.
ai.error.agnes_auth_error: Agnes rejected the key or model permission. Check your key and account access.
ai.error.agnes_rate_limited: Agnes is busy or the account limit was reached. Please try again later.
ai.error.agnes_timeout: Agnes did not respond in time. No replacement image was used.
ai.error.agnes_request_failed: The Agnes request failed. Please try again later.
ai.error.agnes_invalid_image: Agnes did not return a valid image. Please generate again.
ai.error.agent_invalid_output: An agent returned an incomplete result. Please generate again.
ai.error.agent_review_failed: The design did not pass the requirements review. Try clarifying your description.
ai.error.generation_failed: The card could not be completed. Please retry.
ai.error.generation_timeout: Generation took too long. Please try again later.
ai.error.generation_interrupted: Generation was interrupted by a service restart. Please submit again.
ai.error.generation_queue_full: The generation queue is full. Please try again later.
ai.error.network_error: The connection was interrupted. Retry to check the same generation task.
ai.error.database_unavailable: Saved cards are temporarily unavailable. Please retry.
ai.error.idempotency_conflict: This request changed. Please start a new card.
